name: hybrid_neurram_sram_cim
description: Figure 1's mixed row (N2b, E-6): NeuRRAM static tiles beside an SRAM-CIM operand core type, declared as the neurram bundle with its cores overridden (target_overrides), each core type with its own write and compute technology. A design study: no published chip carries both, so it is a declaration over a published target, not a target bundle (a bundle names a published target, target_bundles.py).

cores.note: design study (N2b, E-6): NeuRRAM's 48 static cores of 256 x 256 RRAM cells (wan2022a p.505; written per cell by its write-verify iteration, wan2021edge p.9), each holding 128 x 256 signed weights of two cells on adjacent rows (cells_per_weight 2, weight_cell_rows 2, the neurram chip description's block: 'Each neural-network weight is encoded by the differential conductance between two RRAM cells on adjacent rows along the same column.', wan2022a Methods, PDF p.10; [U-CR C-3] a core type naming the neurram technology states it) beside one SRAM-CIM macro of 128 x 1024 as the operand core type (jiang2023a Section II p.2; written per 8-bit cell, the sram_cim_macro profile's t_write_per_unit); each core type's writes and MACs priced under its own technology (write_physics, compute_physics), every other constant NeuRRAM's; a study declares both counts

onchip_arithmetic.note: [U-CHIPKEYS] the off ablation: NeuRRAM states ReLU in its neuron circuits (onchip_arithmetic classes ['L'], wan2022a p.4), but on-chip lanes and an operand core type do not share a chip on this tree (lane laws over operand banks are not built), so the mixed row runs its activations on the host
